+"""Generate a replayable pick-and-place trajectory for the frozen lime scene."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+s = Session("fruits_green_limes_on_plate", instance="/app/instance.json")
+p = s.primitives()
+
+print("initial ee:", s.ee_pose())
+print("initial objects:", {k: s.objects()[k]["position"] for k in ("lime01", "lime01_01", "clay_plates")})
+
+# TCP is the centre of the fingertip ends. At this height the vertical pads
+# straddle the lower half of a lime without driving the fingers into the table.
+pick_z = 0.045
+hover_z = 0.19
+carry_z = 0.23
+place_z = 0.105
+down = p["top_down_quat"]
+
+s.record_start()
+
+def pick_and_place(name, pick_xy, close_dir, place_xy):
+    yaw = p["yaw_for_closing_dir"](close_dir)
+    quat = down(yaw)
+    x, y = pick_xy
+    print(f"\n{name}: yaw={yaw:.4f}, pick={pick_xy}, place={place_xy}")
+
+    # Approach above the fruit, lower, close, and lift vertically.
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=4)
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, hover_z], quat, speed=0.20, max_dq=0.07)
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, pick_z], quat, speed=0.10, max_dq=0.045, tol=0.004)
+    p["close_gripper"](steps=18)
+    print("after close:", s.objects()[name]["position"], "ee:", s.ee_pose()[0])
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, carry_z], quat, speed=0.12, max_dq=0.06)
+    print("after lift:", s.objects()[name]["position"], "ee:", s.ee_pose()[0])
+
+    # Carry above the plate and lower until the fruit is supported, then detach.
+    px, py = place_xy
+    p["move_ee"]([px, py, carry_z], quat, speed=0.20, max_dq=0.07)
+    p["move_ee"]([px, py, place_z], quat, speed=0.10, max_dq=0.045, tol=0.004)
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=12)
+    p["hold"](steps=12)
+    print("after place:", s.objects()[name]["position"], "status:", s.status())
+
+
+# The first lime is clear of its neighbours when closed along x. The second
+# sits beside an orange, so rotate its jaw axis perpendicular to that neighbour.
+pick_and_place("lime01", (0.4367, 0.10939), (1.0, 0.0), (0.395, -0.365))
+if not s.episode_done:
+    pick_and_place("lime01_01", (0.42902, 0.04455), (0.39, -0.92), (0.420, -0.265))
+
+actions = s.record_stop()
+path = OUT / "trajectory.npz"
+s.save_trajectory(actions, path, meta={"generator": "gen.py", "actions": int(len(actions))})
+print("saved", path, "actions", actions.shape)
+print("live status:", json.dumps(s.status(), sort_keys=True))
+
+# The first in-process replay is deterministic and catches any recording or
+# timing mistake before the artifact is used by the fresh-process verifier.
+replayed = s.replay(actions)
+print("first replay status:", json.dumps(replayed, sort_keys=True))
+if not replayed["success"]:
+    raise SystemExit("recorded trajectory did not succeed on first replay")
+
+s.close()
*** End Patch";
